messages:
maria: Quick q — for the new third-party analytics webhook ingestion, do we need to redact user.email and user.id in staging logs? payload below. thinking to keep a hashed user.id for debugging. also there's a `session_token` field that looks like an oauth token.
```json
{
  "user": {"id": "user_abc123", "email": "alice@example.com"},
  "session_token": "sometoken123",
  "event": "click"
}
```
aj: I would redact `email` and `session_token` in any logs. hashing `user.id` is fine if it's non-reversible (HMAC with a per-environment key). Also what retention are you thinking for staging?
dylan: FYI policy: PII (emails, national ids, phone numbers) must not be stored in plaintext in prod logs. Staging can capture full payloads for debugging but only with explicit approval, limited retention (<=48h), and a scoped access list. Tokens must be redacted everywhere (prod + staging) — treat them as secrets. HMAC (SHA256) with a salt stored in KMS is acceptable; do NOT use reversible/base64 schemes.
lena: infra note — our log-scrubber supports per-source rules. you can add a rule like:
```yaml
source: analytics-webhook
scrub_rules:
  - path: $.user.email
    action: redact
  - path: $.session_token
    action: redact
  - path: $.user.id
    action: hmac
    params:
      key_ref: projects/redwood/keys/staging-scrub-key
      algo: sha256
retention_days: 2
````
maria: perfect. i'll open a short-lived capture for up to 48h if approved, with access only to me + aj + dylan. will add the scrub rules and retention to the pipeline before enabling. can sec confirm approval? @dylan
dylan: approved for 48 hours with conditions: 1) include scrub rules (as above) deployed before capture, 2) create a ticket with the list of people who will access logs, 3) ensure logs are NOT shipped to any external analytics vendor, 4) run deletion job at T+48h and confirm. i'll sign off once the ticket is created. :white_check_mark:
sec-audit-bot: Access record created: SEC-2347. capture window authorized 48h. approver: dylan. audit link: https://redwood.internal/sec/tickets/SEC-2347
maria: thanks all — i'll create SEC-2347 with details and ping when the scrub rules are live. tagging @aj for the code review once i open the PR.
aj: sounds good. i'll keep an eye.
maria: quick follow-up: is it okay to log event metadata (event type, timestamp) unredacted? no user-identifiable fields.
dylan: yes event metadata (non-PII) is fine. keep them minimal. if in doubt, redact.
maria: great, thanks — closing loop.
